answer: Give every identity a slow drip of nectar: non-transferable voice credits that refill one drop at dawn each epoch. To get work attested, an identity spends credits on endorsements, and the k-th endorsement costs k squared — the first is cheap, the fifth costs twenty-five. A lone agent stands on its own narrow ledge and buys one affordable set; a clone farm must buy a full set for every clone, and the quadratic price makes the Nth clone's attestation cost explode, while credits can never be pooled or shared.
